_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_life_event_subjects" ("subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_label" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("subject_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_life_event_life_profiles" ("profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_label" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_life_event_chart_snapshot_refs" ("chart_snapshot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "divination_type_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "sub_divination_type_key" TEXT NULL, "snapshot_revision" TEXT NOT NULL, "algorithm_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "input_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("chart_snapshot_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_life_event_provider_descriptors" ("provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "algorithm_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_version" TEXT NULL, "schema_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "descriptor_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("provider_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_life_event_event_type_descriptors" ("provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_type_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "descriptor_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("provider_id", "event_type_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_life_event_projections" ("projection_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "coverage_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "coverage_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_revision" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chart_snapshot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "divination_type_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "sub_divination_type_key" TEXT NULL, "event_type_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "effective_start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "precision_rank" INTEGER NOT NULL, "projection_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "lifecycle_status" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("projection_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_life_event_coverage_series_heads" ("coverage_series_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chart_snapshot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_type_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "series_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active_coverage_id" TEXT NULL, "candidate_coverage_id" TEXT NULL, "desired_range_start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "desired_range_end_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("coverage_series_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_life_event_coverage_manifests" ("coverage_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "coverage_series_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "coverage_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "manifest_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "serving_state" INTEGER NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chart_snapshot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chart_snapshot_revision" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "algorithm_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_version" TEXT NULL, "event_type_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_type_schema_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "requested_range_start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "requested_range_end_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "covered_ranges_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL, "input_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_shard_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_shard_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_event_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "output_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("coverage_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_life_event_shard_receipts" ("coverage_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shard_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "coverage_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, "requested_range_start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "requested_range_end_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "covered_range_start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "covered_range_end_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "persisted_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "persisted_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_complete_for_covered_range" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_complete_for_covered_range" IN (0, 1)), "input_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "committed_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("coverage_id", "shard_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_user_directions" ("direction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("direction_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_user_annotations" ("annotation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "interpretation" TEXT NULL, "importance_owner_scope_id" TEXT NULL, "importance_catalog_id" TEXT NULL, "importance_catalog_revision" INTEGER NULL, "importance_level_id" TEXT NULL, "tags_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("annotation_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_annotation_target_refs" ("annotation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_revision" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("annotation_id", "provider_id", "source_event_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_annotation_direction_refs" ("annotation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("annotation_id", "direction_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_occurrence_selections" ("selection_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_event_revision" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_revision" TEXT NOT NULL, "annotation_ref" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("selection_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_pattern_rules" ("saved_pattern_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_type_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pattern_schema_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_descriptor_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "matcher_semantic_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_pattern_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "pattern_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "annotation_ref" TEXT NULL, "enabled_for_matching" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("enabled_for_matching" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("saved_pattern_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_pattern_target_refs" ("saved_pattern_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("saved_pattern_id", "target_type", "target_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_rule_templates" ("template_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "provider_pattern_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_direction_ids_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "importance_owner_scope_id" TEXT NULL, "importance_catalog_id" TEXT NULL, "importance_catalog_revision" INTEGER NULL, "importance_level_id" TEXT NULL, "priority_owner_scope_id" TEXT NULL, "priority_catalog_id" TEXT NULL, "priority_catalog_revision" INTEGER NULL, "priority_id" TEXT NULL, "default_channel_ids_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_lead_times_ms_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("template_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_reminder_definitions" ("reminder_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "selection_ref_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "notification_title_override" TEXT NULL, "notification_body_override" TEXT NULL, "priority_owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority_catalog_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority_catalog_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "priority_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lead_times_ms_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "repeat_policy" TEXT NULL, "merge_policy" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("reminder_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_reminder_definition_channels" ("reminder_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("reminder_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_reminder_channels" ("channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "policy_lead_times_ms_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "policy_quiet_hours" TEXT NULL, "policy_merge_window_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "policy_delivery_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "policy_grouping_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("channel_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_reminder_channel_selectors" ("channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "value_a" TEXT NULL, "value_b" TEXT NULL, "value_c" TEXT NULL, "value_d" TEXT NULL, "value_int" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("channel_id", "kind", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_reminder_aggregates" ("aggregate_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "window_start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "window_end_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "priority_owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority_catalog_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority_catalog_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "priority_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_interpretation" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("aggregate_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_reminder_aggregate_directions" ("aggregate_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "direction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("aggregate_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_reminder_aggregate_contributors" ("aggregate_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "divination_type_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "sub_divination_type_key" TEXT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "chart_snapshot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_revision" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_type_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fact_summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "evidence_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "severity_provider_id" TEXT NULL, "severity_scheme_id" TEXT NULL, "severity_scheme_version" TEXT NULL, "severity_code" TEXT NULL, "provider_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "algorithm_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule_version" TEXT NULL, "data_version" TEXT NULL, "annotation_ref" TEXT NULL, "direction_ids_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "importance_owner_scope_id" TEXT NULL, "importance_catalog_id" TEXT NULL, "importance_catalog_revision" INTEGER NULL, "importance_level_id" TEXT NULL, "reminder_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("aggregate_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_reminder_schedules" ("schedule_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reminder_id" TEXT NULL, "aggregate_id" TEXT NULL, "fire_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "display_timezone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "channel_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_revision_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "claim_token" TEXT NULL, "lease_expires_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("schedule_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_reminder_deliveries" ("delivery_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "schedule_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempted_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "stable_error_code" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("delivery_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_external_events" ("owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "divination_type_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "sub_divination_type_key" TEXT NULL, "event_time_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event_end_ms" INTEGER NULL, "event_precision" INTEGER NULL, "fact_summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "evidence_ref" TEXT NULL, "lifecycle_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "used_profile_refs_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "saved_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_latest" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_latest" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("owner_scope_id", "external_event_id", "revision"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "t_le_external_event_subjects" ("owner_scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_event_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_scope_id", "external_event_id", "revision", "subject_id", "position"));
